environment.description: Lambda function deployed with Function URL enabled (auth_type=AWS_IAM). The resource-based policy on the Lambda function specifies a Condition block requiring 'aws:PrincipalOrgID' matching 'o-a1b2c3d4e5' and the FunctionUrlAuthType is set to AWS_IAM which means the Lambda service automatically validates Signature Version 4 on incoming requests before invocation. Unsigned or incorrectly signed requests receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda URL invoke endpoint itself (pre-function). The SQS queue resource policy restricts sqs:SendMessage to principals within the same AWS Organization (Condition: aws:PrincipalOrgID equals o-a1b2c3d4e5). Additionally, the SQS queue has a dead-letter queue redrive policy with maxReceiveCount=3 and content-based deduplication enabled on the source queue (FIFO).

config.network: VPC with private subnets, VPC endpoint for SQS
config.iam_role: AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole + sqs:ReceiveMessage + sqs:DeleteMessage (permission boundary: deny sqs:* on queues outside account)
